optimized_ci_run.failed_step: Build raw per-window native audio track and mux MP4
optimized_ci_run.visual_render: completed in 2m22s with cached static UI
optimized_ci_run.cause: All 16 measured per-window gain / mastering combinations failed the unchanged web gate lra_in_range; LRA was about 87-89 LU and movement about 225-229 dB because selected native-audio windows contained long digital-silence blocks.
optimized_ci_run.fix: Strengthen source selection and auditing: every complete 0.5s block of each 8.6s native window must exceed the unchanged -65 dBFS audible threshold; no added audio, no substituted audio and no weakened web gates.

continuous_audio_fix.problem: Selected native-audio windows had long -120 dBFS silence gaps despite passing the aggregate 8.6s RMS gate.
continuous_audio_fix.fix: Probe, selection, source audit, audio builder ledger and technical QC now require every complete 0.5s block to exceed -65 dBFS.
